final: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref AS project_id, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), fractions AS (SELECT project_id, qc_count, 1.0 * qc_count / NULLIF(SUM(qc_count) OVER (), 0) AS fraction FROM project_counts), average_fraction AS (SELECT AVG(fraction) AS avg_fraction FROM fractions) SELECT f.project_id, f.qc_count, f.fraction, f.fraction - a.avg_fraction AS difference FROM fractions AS f CROSS JOIN average_fraction AS a WHERE a.avg_fraction IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC, difference IS NULL, f.project_id LIMIT 10
